name: check-grid
title: Check Grid
description: A script that lists what in an app's own code is off agentui's grid (docs/grid.md), so its views keep to it as the components do: sizes and space on the 4px module, boxes from 96px on the 16px gutter, space a step of the scale (4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 96, 128), glyphs 12, 14, 16 or 20px, type a named size on whole lines, a colour's opacity, a duration and a layer each one of their few, the viewport's one breakpoint (sm), and pixel constants and size props (`width={280}`) on the same rules. `node scripts/check-grid.ts [files or directories…]`, src/components and src/lib by default (.ts and .tsx); it exits 1 with what it found, for CI. A comment `grid: mark` above a line skips it (a mark, a dot, a handle), `grid: clear (…)` its space (room kept for a box), `motion:` its duration (a loop's or a stream's); a duration or an easing of a component's own (`duration-200`, `ease-[cubic-bezier(…)]`), not the theme's motion-hover, -fade, -size, -slide or -pop. Node 23.6 or later (it runs as TypeScript).
